narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Reliance Industries demonstrated strong operational execution across FY26 and Q1 FY27, consistently delivering on digital subscriber ramp-up and retail footprint expansion. The company crossed key operational thresholds, reaching 20,000 retail stores in Q4 FY26 and growing digital services by 20% year-on-year in Q1 FY27, while FMCG demerger execution saw only minor timing slippage from November to 1st December.

guided.guidance: Scale up and ramp up digital services launched over the prior couple of quarters
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (26-Apr-2026), PDF p. 31 — "of course, digital services. We have launched a few in the last couple of quarters and we want them to scale up, ramp up."

guided.guidance: Optimistic about working at scale to increase the run rate and increase the acquisition rate even more
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (26-Apr-2026), PDF p. 5 — "So, we are very optimistic about this working at scale and will help us increase the run rate, increase the acquisition rate even more."

delivered.actual: Digital services growth reached 20% year-on-year, outpacing connectivity growth
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (19-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "The digital services growth is 20% year-on-year, which outpaces the connectivity growth, which has been the trend over the last several quarters."

delivered.actual: Fixed broadband connects increased to 28.6 million, out of which 14 million are AirFiber homes
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (19-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "The home broadband, fixed broadband connects has increased to 28.6 million, out of which 14 million are AirFiber homes."

quarters.commentary: Digital services scaled up rapidly with double-digit growth outpacing connectivity, and home broadband additions expanded to 28.6 million connections driven by AirFiber.

guided.guidance: Store count stood at close to 20,000 stores after having added about 430 stores
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (18-Jan-2026), PDF p. 3 — "Overall store count at close to 20,000 stores and having added about 430 stores."

guided.guidance: Continue to add almost a million homes every month
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (18-Jan-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Homes, we continue to add almost a million homes every month."

delivered.actual: Opened 333 total new stores during the quarter and crossed the milestone of 20,000 stores
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (26-Apr-2026), PDF p. 7 — "We opened 333 total new stores during the quarter and crossed the milestone of 20,000 stores during this quarter."

delivered.actual: Reached 27 million fixed broadband connects with an addition of almost 10 million during the year and 12.9 million JioAirFiber homes
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (26-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "27 million fixed broadband connects that was a net addition of almost 10 million during the year and 12.9 million JioAirFiber homes."

quarters.commentary: Reliance crossed the major operational threshold of 20,000 retail stores and sustained home broadband additions to reach 27 million connects.

guided.guidance: Targeted that the de-merger will happen in November pending written judgment
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "so this is something that the de-merger will happen in November, but we are waiting for the written judgment on that one."

guided.guidance: Reached 23 million fixed broadband connected premises with 3 million net adds in the quarter
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Oct-2025), PDF p. 5 — "23 million fixed broadband connected premises, 3 million net adds in this quarter. So, our million a month kind of run rate has sustained"

delivered.actual: The demerger happened on 1st December with turnover crossing 5,000 Crores
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (18-Jan-2026), PDF p. 3 — "On the FMCG side, the demerger happened on 1st December. And we are at more than 5,000 Crores of turnover"

delivered.actual: Maintained run rate reaching 25 million plus fixed broadband connects and 11.5 million JioAirFiber homes
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (18-Jan-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Now we maintain that run rate, 25 million plus fixed broadband connects, and 11.5 million JioAirFiber homes."

quarters.commentary: Broadband additions maintained the run rate to reach 25 million connects, while the FMCG demerger was completed with a slight delay into 1st December.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management reliably converts proprietary technology and physical infrastructure rollouts into steady volume and subscriber milestones, with corporate actions occasionally shifting by a few weeks due to regulatory processes.
